name: Nanuya Lailai
bio_draft: Island: next to the Blue Lagoon and Turtle Island; Wikivoyage lists a walk over the island with views, the Blue Lagoon snorkel and diving from its dive shop.

name: Waya Lailai
bio_draft: Island: also called Wayasewa, with a rocky volcanic peak at its centre; Wikivoyage recommends the climb to the top for sunrise, and a three-hour walk across the island to Naboro village.

name: Sigatoka Sand Dunes National Park
bio_draft: National park: Fiji's first national park, 20–60 m parabolic dunes at the Sigatoka River mouth with archaeological sites.

name: Natadola Beach
bio_draft: Beach: white-sand beach west of Sigatoka, considered one of the best in Fiji, with shade trees and horse riding.

name: Beqa Island
bio_draft: island: lagoon island 10 km off Viti Levu, base for shark dives and firewalking villages, reached by boat from Pacific Harbour

name: Beqa Shark Reef
bio_draft: Dive site: Shark Reef marine park in the Beqa lagoon, dived from Pacific Harbour with shark-dive operators; the place, not an operator.
